title: Composed supervisory control: Two-out-of-three sensor voter -> Good/reject batch statistics with reject lockout

inputs.name: B_BatchTarget
inputs.description: Subsystem B: Total parts in a batch

outputs.name: B_QualityFault
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Reject count exceeded limit

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: Subsystem A: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem A: Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem A: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem B: B_BatchTarget and B_RejectLimit remain positive and constant during a test.
Subsystem B: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.
B_BatchTarget remains within the closed interval [-4, 4] during a test.
B_RejectLimit remains within the closed interval [-4, 4] during a test.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Vote shall be TRUE when at least two of A_S1, A_S2, and A_S3 are TRUE.
requirements.property: G(A_Vote = ((A_S1 AND A_S2) OR (A_S1 AND A_S3) OR (A_S2 AND A_S3)))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Unanimous shall be TRUE only when all three channels have the same value.
requirements.property: G(A_Unanimous = ((A_S1 AND A_S2 AND A_S3) OR ((!A_S1) AND (!A_S2) AND (!A_S3))))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: A good-part rising edge increments only B_GoodCount; a reject-part rising edge increments only B_RejectCount.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Simultaneous good and reject edges shall count one reject and no good part.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((rose(B_GoodPart) AND rose(B_RejectPart) AND !B_Reset) -> (B_RejectCount=prev(B_RejectCount)+1 AND B_GoodCount=prev(B_GoodCount))))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_BatchDone shall be TRUE when B_GoodCount plus B_RejectCount reaches B_BatchTarget.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_QualityFault shall latch when B_RejectCount reaches B_RejectLimit and remain set until B_Reset.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Reset shall clear both counts, B_BatchDone, and B_QualityFault.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (B_Reset -> (B_GoodCount=0 AND B_RejectCount=0 AND !B_BatchDone AND !B_QualityFault)))

requirements.text: A TRUE A_Vote shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
requirements.property: G(CrossReset -> (!CrossReady AND B_GoodCount=0 AND B_RejectCount=0 AND NOT B_BatchDone AND NOT B_QualityFault)) AND G((NOT (SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady)) -> (B_GoodCount=0 AND B_RejectCount=0 AND NOT B_BatchDone AND NOT B_QualityFault))

requirements.text: Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

composition.runtime_design: one stateful subsystem plus one stateless Boolean subsystem

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
